summary: Iteration 116 — Alert Channels + Snooze + Audit Export. Backend 8/8 pytest PASS (governance-settings new keys, email/webhook validation, snooze set+clear w/ audit entries, CSV, CSV?trusted=true, PDF, PDF?trusted=true). Frontend UI: new inputs render, snooze picker renders, audit trusted-filter chip narrows list (200→41) and only trusted actions visible, CSV/PDF export buttons present & enabled, clear button works. HOWEVER round-trip Save is BROKEN for the two new channel fields.

ui_bugs.issue: gov-save PUT payload is missing alert_channel_emails and alert_channel_webhook. User-entered values in gov-alert-emails and gov-alert-webhook are silently discarded on Save (backend never receives them). Reproduced: typed soc@example.com,ciso@example.com + a valid https Slack webhook, clicked gov-save, reloaded — inputs re-hydrated to previous values (proving the PUT didn't include them).

After clicking gov-snooze-btn (24h), the block did not flip to show gov-snooze-status + gov-snooze-resume within 1.5s wait (both stayed invisible; picker stayed visible). Backend POST /runtime/alerts/snooze works (pytest passes, audit entry created), so this appears to be a client-side render/state issue in doSnooze — possibly setS is called on the prev state but a subsequent hydrate/other effect overwrites, or new Date(ISO with +00:00) is failing the future-comparison. Needs a retest after a small pause / verify state flow.

integration_issues.flow: Save governance channel settings from UI
integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/agents/runtime/governance-settings body sent by the UI omits alert_channel_emails and alert_channel_webhook fields entirely, so the new inputs are non-functional despite the backend fully supporting them (see backend pytest — direct PUT works).

action_items: Add alert_channel_emails and alert_channel_webhook to the saveAll() PUT payload in frontend/src/components/agentic-ai/DefensibilityDashboard.jsx (~L339-356). Parse alertEmails via split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean); pass alertWebhook as-is.

Debug snooze UI: after doSnooze success, gov-snooze-status/gov-snooze-resume did not become visible. Verify (a) setS is receiving the new snooze_alerts_until (log data.snooze_alerts_until), (b) new Date(iso) > new Date() evaluates true, (c) no useEffect rehydrate is racing. Consider also awaiting a small state settle before re-checking.
critical_code_review_comments: DefensibilityDashboard.jsx saveAll(): payload spec drift — every other input in the card is included in the PUT except the two new channel fields. Easy to miss on future edits; consider building the payload from a single object mapped to state so new fields can't be forgotten.

AuditLog.jsx exportFile uses api.get with responseType:'blob'; verify axios instance forwards credentials (cookie) for cross-origin — appears fine but not exercised for blob downloads in this test batch beyond click-visibility.
agents.py audit_log_csv/pdf endpoints do not include _id in output (find({},{_id:0}) — good). CSV/PDF admin-guarded via Depends(require_roles('admin')) — good.
seed_data_creation: Backend test added 'ZZ' (or removed if present) to trusted_countries once to generate an agent.trusted_rules_changed entry for the CSV?trusted=true assertion. Also persisted alert_channel_emails=[alice@example.com,bob@example.com] and a test slack webhook on the owner org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two frontend bugs above (saveAll omits new fields; snooze UI does not flip after click) are the only blockers for feature acceptance. Backend is fully working (8/8 pytest). When retesting, note that the owner org already has TEST alert_channel_emails persisted from this run — a fresh Save from the UI should overwrite them if the bug is fixed. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter116_alert_channels_snooze_export.py for regression.
rca of the issue: GovernanceSettingsCard.saveAll() builds the PUT payload as an explicit object literal that lists every field except alert_channel_emails and alert_channel_webhook — a copy-paste omission when the two new state vars (alertEmails, alertWebhook) were added. Fix: add `alert_channel_emails: alertEmails.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean), alert_channel_webhook: alertWebhook` to the api.put body. For snooze UI: doSnooze does setS(prev => ({...prev, snooze_alerts_until: data.snooze_alerts_until||''})); the branch renders based on `s.snooze_alerts_until && new Date(s.snooze_alerts_until) > new Date()`. Confirm data.snooze_alerts_until returned by POST /runtime/alerts/snooze is a fully-qualified ISO with tz (it is — .isoformat() on tz-aware datetime), and rule out that the earlier hydrate() from a concurrent GET is not overwriting after the POST resolves.
